title: Nothing you can see: source-use conflicts now clear themselves
items: Nothing in the town changed. Behind it, the list of source-use files that a merge may rebuild instead of refusing had fallen to 303 of the 436 it should name. The other 134 conflicts stopped a branch's merge, or lost its source links when one side was taken by hand. The compiler that writes those files now keeps the list itself, and the gate refuses when the two disagree.
